text: I'm from Taraz, which is a fairly old city in the south of Kazakhstan, not far from the border with Kyrgyzstan. It's actually over two thousand years old, so there's quite a lot of history there, although these days it's mostly known for its markets and its mild climate.

tips.en: It names the city straight away, then adds where it is and why it is interesting — the answer does not stop at one word.
tips.kk: Қаланы бірден атайды, сосын оның қайда екенін және несімен қызық екенін қосады — жауап бір сөзбен бітпейді.
tips.ru: Сразу называет город, затем добавляет, где он и чем интересен, — ответ не обрывается на одном слове.
tips.example: which is a fairly old city in the south of Kazakhstan

tips.en: Although adds a second angle: the history and what the city is known for today.
tips.kk: Although екінші көзқарасты қосады: тарихы және қазір несімен танымал екені.
tips.ru: Although добавляет второй взгляд: история и то, чем город известен сейчас.
tips.example: although these days it's mostly known for its markets

note.en: Softens the description — natural in conversation.
note.ru: Смягчает оценку: «довольно» — звучит естественно в разговоре.

note.en: Actually introduces an interesting fact that may surprise the listener.
note.kk: Actually таң қалдыруы мүмкін қызық деректі енгізеді.
note.ru: Actually вводит интересный факт, который может удивить.

questions.question: Let's talk about your hometown. Where is it?

text: I'd say it's the pace of life. Compared to Almaty, everything is much more relaxed, so people actually have time to stop and chat. I also love the food markets — you can pick up fresh fruit for next to nothing, especially in late summer.

tips.en: The first sentence answers the question; the next one explains it through a comparison and a result.
tips.kk: Бірінші сөйлем сұраққа жауап береді, келесісі салыстыру мен салдар арқылы түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Первая фраза отвечает на вопрос, следующая объясняет через сравнение и следствие.
tips.example: I'd say it's the pace of life

tips.en: Comparing with another city makes the point concrete.
tips.kk: Басқа қаламен салыстыру ойды нақты етеді.
tips.ru: Сравнение с другим городом делает мысль конкретной.
tips.example: Compared to Almaty, everything is much more relaxed

note.en: A natural way to start an opinion answer.
note.kk: Пікір туралы сұраққа жауаптың табиғи басы.
note.ru: Естественное начало ответа на вопрос о мнении.

questions.followUp: Why is that important to you?
questions.question: What do you like most about your hometown?

text: Definitely the public transport. The buses are quite old and they don't run very often, so most people end up relying on taxis. If the city invested in a few modern bus routes, I think it would make a huge difference, especially for students.

tips.en: Three steps in three sentences — developed, but not too long.
tips.kk: Үш сөйлемде үш қадам — жауап ашылған, бірақ созылмаған.
tips.ru: Три шага в трёх предложениях — ответ развит, но не затянут.
tips.example: so most people end up relying on taxis

tips.en: If + past, would shows grammatical range naturally.
tips.kk: If + past, would — грамматикалық ауқымды табиғи түрде көрсетеді.
tips.ru: If + past, would — показывает грамматический диапазон естественно.
tips.example: If the city invested in a few modern bus routes

note.en: “Finally have to depend on” — a lively spoken structure.
note.ru: «В итоге вынуждены полагаться на» — живая разговорная конструкция.

note.en: A set phrase: “improve something a lot”.

questions.followUp: Why do you think that hasn't happened yet?
questions.question: Is there anything you would like to change about it?

text: Yes, quite a lot. When I was little, the centre was mostly small shops and old Soviet buildings, but over the last ten years a lot of cafés and new apartment blocks have appeared. It feels more modern now, although some people miss the old atmosphere.

tips.en: Past simple for childhood, present perfect for changes up to now.
tips.kk: Балалық шаққа past simple, бүгінге дейінгі өзгерістерге present perfect.
tips.ru: Past simple для детства, present perfect для перемен до сегодняшнего дня.
tips.example: a lot of cafés and new apartment blocks have appeared

tips.en: The answer not only praises the changes but notes that not everyone likes them.
tips.kk: Жауап өзгерістерді мақтап қана қоймай, оларды бәрі қабылдамайтынын да байқайды.
tips.ru: Ответ не только хвалит перемены, но и замечает, что их принимают не все.
tips.example: although some people miss the old atmosphere

note.en: A conversational way to say “when I was a child”.
A time period that goes with the present perfect.

questions.followUp: Do you think those changes are positive?
questions.question: Has your hometown changed much since you were a child?

text: Probably not in the near future, to be honest. There are far more job opportunities in bigger cities, especially in IT. But I can definitely imagine moving back later on, maybe when I have a family, because it's a much calmer place to raise children.

tips.en: Probably and to be honest soften the “no” — this is how fluent speakers sound.
tips.kk: Probably және to be honest «жоқты» жұмсартады — ана тілінде сөйлейтіндер осылай айтады.
tips.ru: Probably и to be honest смягчают «нет» — так звучат носители.
tips.example: Probably not in the near future, to be honest

tips.en: Now — jobs, later — family: the answer looks both ways.
tips.kk: Қазір — жұмыс, кейін — отбасы: жауап екі жаққа қарайды.
tips.ru: Сейчас — работа, потом — семья: ответ смотрит в две стороны.
tips.example: maybe when I have a family

note.en: An honest aside that makes the answer personal.

questions.followUp: What would make you go back?
questions.question: Would you like to live there in the future?
